label: Extension tool filtering is opt-in (enabled:false, maxAdded 8): it withholds declared tools via setActiveTools, gates codemode/deferred tools at tool_call, grows availability additively per branch, and is explicitly not a sandbox.

Our native tool surface is one MCP server (code_mode, in .mcp.json and opencode.json) exposing seven fixed meta-tools; the 13 UTCP manuals' ~200 tools reach context only via model-pulled search_tools with a limit. The over-advertising problem does not exist here.

REJECT porting the advertisement-side tool filter: nothing to withhold beyond seven fixed meta-tools; search_tools already takes the model's own task description. Confirm by measuring declared-schema token size in a fresh session.

REJECT an advisor-scored call gate on Code Mode: call_tool_chain reaches all registered tools by design and the launcher does no filtering, but a probabilistic relevance gate is the wrong safety control; binding controls are static agent permissions and host prompts.

ADAPT (no new work): the extension's essentials-always-allowed floor is already mirrored by static allowed-tools skill frontmatter and agent permission blocks; do not rebuild allowlist machinery for tools.

The extension fails closed for the tool gate but has an open/closed setting for advertisements, supporting iteration 2: failure polarity must follow function (access gate closed, additive advertisement open).
